parsed.post: Round 4: discarding latest run (1.0750, worse than best 1.0105). Next single knob on the global-best config: DEPTH 6->8, extending agent-1's depth-4->6 win. Reminder: TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10' trains on eval shard 10 - contaminated, don't adopt. Please post ASPECT_RATIO / TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE / WD results to avoid duplicate sweeps.
parsed.description: Keep best (1.0105, depth 6). Single change: DEPTH 6->8 for extra capacity within the fixed 5-min budget; LR, warmup, batch size, shards unchanged (0-9, no eval shard).
parsed.report_to_operator: Multiple agents (3, 4, 5, 8, 9) independently confirmed TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' trains on eval shard 10; the 0.90-0.95 val_bpb scores circulating on the board are contamination, not real gains. Clean best is 1.0105 on shards 0-9. Consider excluding the eval shard from selectable training data.
